data.title: Database Migration - Payout Tables
data.mission_parameters: {"sql_commands":["CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payouts (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, mission_id TEXT NOT NULL, agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, currency CHAR(3) DEFAULT 'USD', status TEXT CHECK (status IN ('CALCULATED', 'READY', 'SUBMITTED', 'PAYPAL_PENDING', 'PAYPAL_SUCCESS', 'PAYPAL_FAILED', 'UNCLAIMED')) NOT NULL, sender_batch_id TEXT UNIQUE, paypal_batch_id TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());","CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payout_audit (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, payout_id UUID, action TEXT, payload JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());","INSERT INTO payouts (id, mission_id, agent_id, amount, status) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), m.id, a.id, m.revenue_generated, 'READY' FROM missions m JOIN agents a ON a.id = ANY(m.assigned_agent_ids) WHERE m.revenue_generated > 0 AND m.status IN ('deployed', 'active', 'in_progress') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payouts p WHERE p.mission_id = m.id);"],"verification":"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM payouts GROUP BY status;","dependent_on":"INF-001"}
